infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: AQUILITY needs camera access to scan test strips.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: AQUILITY needs photo library access so you can upload strip images from your device.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: AQUILITY needs your location to tag scan results and map nearby water quality.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: AQUILITY can optionally access location while the app is in use for map-based features.
